summary: The Iron Snail reviews and explains men's clothing and gear, from boots and raw denim to waxed and wool jackets and t-shirts, with hands-on tests and history. He also designs his own clothing line, including the Mammoth wool jacket.

journey.title: Boot reviews with waterproof tests
journey.text: The Iron Snail reviewed Blundstone Chelsea boots, including a puddle test of the leather's water resistance, alongside leather-care how-tos.

citations.quote: The Blundstone 550's in rustic brown is certainly an attractive boot, but does it live up to the hype?

journey.title: Long-term wear updates
journey.text: He began revisiting gear after a year of use, such as a one-year progress report on Levi's 501 raw denim.

citations.quote: Here's a little breakdown of my Levi 501's after 1 year of wear

journey.title: Prologue jacket orders
journey.text: The Iron Snail took orders for his own Prologue jacket and updated buyers on its delivery timing.

citations.quote: the iron snail prologue jackets are delayed until mid-February

journey.title: Jacket 'Olympics' comparison format
journey.text: He launched a seasonal comparison format that scores several jackets against each other, starting with waxed jackets.

citations.quote: today on the wax jacket Olympics we will be looking at four wax jackets

journey.title: Second channel for vlogs
journey.text: The Iron Snail started a second channel, The Tale of The Iron Snail, for vlogs.

citations.quote: NEW CHANNEL (sorry for the posting delay): @TheTaleofTheIronSnail
the second channel the tail the iron snail the Vlog channel is officially live

journey.title: Mammoth jacket launch
journey.text: He introduced the Mammoth, his own made-in-America wool jacket, in a roundup of winter wool jackets, with pre-orders through his site.

journey.title: Community-voted rankings
journey.text: The Iron Snail began ranking the items viewers voted the internet's favourites, starting with t-shirts and later sweatshirts, waxed jackets and down jackets.

citations.quote: I downloaded all of your comments on my last t-shirt video and tallied the most mentioned brands that I didn't include

journey.title: Expanding the product line
journey.text: He showed in-development Iron Snail products, including American-made selvedge denim, jeans, t-shirts, sweaters and a new Mammoth version.

citations.quote: I just got back from a lovely little trip to Pennsylvania to see the first ever Iron Snail made in USA salvage denim.

ventures.title: Prologue jacket
ventures.text: An Iron Snail jacket sold to customers by late 2022, which he said was coming back in 2025.

citations.quote: the iron snail prologue jackets are delayed until mid-February
the prologue jacket which is coming back soon

ventures.title: Mammoth jacket
ventures.text: A heavy, double-layered 28 oz wool jacket made in America with custom fabric and knit cuffs, priced at $550. A Mammoth V3 was in development in 2025.

citations.quote: the retail price of the mammoth is $550
This is the Mammoth V3 that is coming out later this year in black, in blue, and buffalo plaid

ventures.title: Iron Snail x Russell Moccasin Premier Chukka
ventures.text: A collaboration boot with Russell Moccasin based on an archival design.

citations.quote: This is the Iron Snail X Russell moccasin Premier Chucka, a boot that we found in the archives

ventures.title: Dinghy Skipper wallet
ventures.text: A leather wallet made in collaboration with Bronson Leather Works.

citations.quote: These are a collaboration between me and Bronson Leather Works.

ventures.title: Cardinal t-shirt
ventures.text: An Iron Snail t-shirt in development in two versions, including a value option using custom fabric made in North Carolina.

citations.quote: The first fabric for the cheaper Cardinal, the Leafline one, is custom Iron Snail fabric made in North Carolina.

ventures.title: Chapter 1 jeans
ventures.text: Iron Snail jeans made from the brand's own American-made selvedge denim, shown as samples in 2025.

ventures.title: Billy Goat sweater
ventures.text: An Iron Snail wool sweater that he says he wears more than any other.

citations.quote: This is the Iron Snail Billy Goat sweater.
